fixed_constraints: Docs must match shipped behavior: READMEs, index, ledger, coverage, plan, CLI guides, and new release notes follow actual command output, minus proof, compatibility, obsolete-syntax, and unsupported-platform claims.
Historical design material keeps labels plus links and is never silently recast as current authority, honoring the frozen contract's bar on quiet rewrites.
No release notes exist; signing, notarization, and upload remain open gates served by prepared commands only, with provider quality unclaimed.
Verified contract-to-evidence links, exact pins and limits, a clean-machine install-to-run pass, and a recount of fifty checkboxes gate completion.
common.purpose: Determine the three open I50 design points for Can documentation: REQUIREMENTS.md fate, release-notes shape, and docs index scope.

index_scope.background: The docs index pairs dated design links against a status map plus reading steps that assume live sketches, sketch-side goldens, and a CAN-code registry, none surviving.
facts: Lower-half historical-incomplete labels exist, yet the reading order still tours deleted sketches and golden gates as though live.
The ledger, coverage mapping, evidence directories, and package READMEs form current authority without index prominence.
Anchor-preserving relabels contrast with rebuilds that threaten deep links from evidence and review notes aimed at existing headings.

release_notes_shape.background: Shipped state, pins, open gates, install flow, and limits need one release-notes home, either new under implementation or inside the distribution guide.
facts: I01/I02/I39 sections of distribution/README.md already span install, upgrade, prepared signing, and the unsigned-release open gate.
No consolidated notes bind version, pins, gates, and limits despite outward links from root README, ledger, and evidence.
Implementation files own task evidence and distribution files own shipping steps, stranding notes between two readerships.

requirements_fate.background: A 288-line frozen v0.1 contract of decision tables, given/call evidence, revision pins, and CAN codes fills root REQUIREMENTS.md, retired throughout by the shipped compiler.
facts: Silent rewrites stand banned by its freeze rule with tagged amendments as the sole legal change, barring quiet modernization.
Living-contract billing in index and root README still funnels readers past it into deleted sketch programs.
Enforcement moved entirely to ledger, coverage mapping, and evidence directories; no present test, gate, or example honors its clauses.
